title: ChatGPT for automated grading of short-answer questions in mechanical ventilation examinations

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'submitted together as prompts to the ChatGPT 4o API (model "gpt-4-turbo"), with maximum token value of 4,000 and a temperature setting of 0.'

prompt.note: Question stems and rubrics are part of the closed course material.

claim.metric: mean difference LLM minus human grade (10-point scale)
claim.location: Abstract and Table 2 (mean difference -1.34; ICC1=0.086; Cohen's kappa=-0.0786)

data.source: 557 de-identified student answers, rubrics and human grades from a University of Sydney postgraduate course (not released)

notes: Model naming is contradictory ('ChatGPT 4o API' with model id gpt-4-turbo); five sessions were run to measure session variance.
